symptom: ako/mxcli#2071 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1791): `alter page M.P { insert into lgMain { row { column { … } } } }` failed with 'row needs a name'; with `row r2` it failed with 'it is not a simple container'. Only INSERT AFTER a widget inside a column worked.
cause: An INSERT's nodes were built one by one as widgets, and a layout grid row is not a widget: the generic builder demands a name it never stores, and InsertWidget appends to a Widgets list a layout grid does not have. Tab pages had the same shape and got their own path in #1215.
insight: Every non-widget child kind (tab page, list view template, navigation list item, now layout grid row) needs its own insert path; the tell is a list key other than Widgets. A row has no stored Name, so INTO the grid is its only position: refuse BEFORE/AFTER with the INTO form named rather than invent an address. Verified on TestApp: both reported forms append, describe → create or modify reports Unchanged, mx check 0 errors.
